testCases.title: Verify brand filter is displayed on the product overview page
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
expectedResults: The brand filter is displayed on the product overview page.

testCases.title: Verify selecting brand checkboxes updates the product grid
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
Select one or more brand checkboxes.
expectedResults: The product grid updates to show only products from the selected brands.

testCases.title: Verify combined filtering by brand and categories
steps: Navigate to the product overview page.
Select one or more brand checkboxes.
Select one or more category checkboxes.
expectedResults: The product grid shows only products matching both the selected brands and categories.
